$comment: Each case is one message to the bot, as the person would type it in its chat or on Telegram. {{project}} is BOT_EVAL_PROJECT. `card` is text the start_session card must contain (the server's own reading of the launch); `input` is fields the call must carry exactly; `absent` is fields it must not carry (a choice nobody made, so the default holds); `refused` is a case where the start must not reach a card and the reply must name one of `mentions`.
